r left join sys_user u on r.user_id = u.user_id left join sys_dept d on r.dept_id = d.dept_id left join pm_daily_report_detail dd on r.report_id = dd.report_id left join pm_project p on dd.project_id mapper.insert:
insert into pm_daily_report
report_date, user_id, dept_id, total_work_hours, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark,
#{reportDate}, #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{totalWorkHours}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark},
mapper.delete:
DELETE FROM pm_daily_report WHERE report_id in
#{reportId}
mapper.select:
select u.user_id as userId, u.nick_name as nickName, d.dept_name as deptName from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id
u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and u.user_id not in (select user_id from pm_daily_report_whitelist where del_flag = '0')
and ( u.user_id in ( select project_manager_id from pm_project where project_id = #{projectId} and del_flag = '0' union select team_leader_id from pm_project where project_id = #{projectId} and del_flag = '0' and team_leader_id is not null union select user_id from pm_project_member where project_id = #{projectId} and is_active = '1' and del_flag = '0' ) )
and (u.dept_id = #{deptId} or u.dept_id in (select dept_id from sys_dept where find_in_set(#{deptId}, ancestors) > 0))
${params.dataScope}
order by d.dept_name, u.nick_name

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.dept_id
u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' AND u.user_id != 1 AND u.user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM pm_daily_report_whitelist WHERE del_flag = '0')
AND u.user_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT pm.user_id FROM pm_project_member pm INNER JOIN pm_project p_pn ON pm.project_id = p_pn.project_id WHERE pm.is_active = '1' AND pm.del_flag = '0' AND p_pn.del_flag = '0' AND p_pn.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{projectName}, '%') )
${params.dataScope}

SELECT dates.d AS reportDate, COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS totalCount FROM ( SELECT DATE_ADD(#{startDate}, INTERVAL t.n DAY) AS d FROM ( SELECT a.N + b.N * 10 AS n FROM (SELECT 0 AS N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9) a, (SELECT 0 AS N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4) b ) t WHERE DATE_ADD(#{startDate}, INTERVAL t.n DAY) <= #{endDate} ) dates INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' AND u.user_id != 1 AND DATE(u.create_time) <= dates.d AND u.user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM pm_daily_report_whitelist WHERE del_flag = '0') LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.dept_id
AND u.user_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT pm.user_id FROM pm_project_member pm INNER JOIN pm_project p_pn ON pm.project_id = p_pn.project_id WHERE pm.is_active = '1' AND pm.del_flag = '0' AND p_pn.del_flag = '0' AND p_pn.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{projectName}, '%') )
${params.dataScope}
GROUP BY dates.d

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.nick_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS nickName, d.dept_name AS deptName FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.dept_id
u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' AND u.user_id != 1 AND u.user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM pm_daily_report_whitelist WHERE del_flag = '0') AND DATE(u.create_time) <= #{reportDate} AND u.user_id NOT IN ( SELECT r.user_id FROM pm_daily_report r WHERE r.report_date = #{reportDate} AND r.del_flag = '0' )
AND u.user_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT pm.user_id FROM pm_project_member pm INNER JOIN pm_project p_pn ON pm.project_id = p_pn.project_id WHERE pm.is_active = '1' AND pm.del_flag = '0' AND p_pn.del_flag = '0' AND p_pn.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{projectName}, '%') )
${params.dataScope}
ORDER BY d.dept_name, u.nick_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci

SELECT DISTINCT p.project_id AS projectId, p.project_name AS projectName FROM pm_project p INNER JOIN pm_project_member m ON m.project_id = p.project_id AND m.is_active = '1' AND m.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = m.user_id INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id
p.del_flag = '0'
AND (p.project_dept = #{deptId} OR p.project_dept IN ( SELECT dept_id FROM sys_dept WHERE FIND_IN_SET(#{deptId}, ancestors) > 0 ))
AND p.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{projectName}, '%')
${params.dataScope}
ORDER BY p.project_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LIMIT 20

SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.project_name AS projectName, p.estimated_workload AS estimatedWorkload, ROUND(p.actual_workload / 8, 3) + COALESCE(p.adjust_workload, 0) AS actualPersonDays, (pc.project_id IS NOT NULL) AS hasContract, p.project_stage AS projectStage, p.revenue_confirm_year AS revenueConfirmYear, p.confirm_amount AS confirmAmount, p.revenue_confirm_status AS revenueConfirmStatus, p.project_budget AS projectBudget, COALESCE(pc.contractAmount, 0) AS contractAmount,
pd.dept_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS projectDeptName, u.user_id AS userId, u.nick_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS nickName, d.dept_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS deptName, m.isFormer AS isFormer,
CASE WHEN p.project_manager_id = u.user_id THEN '项目经理' WHEN p.market_manager_id = u.user_id THEN '市场经理' WHEN p.sales_manager_id = u.user_id THEN '销售负责人' WHEN FIND_IN_SET(u.user_id, p.participants) > 0 THEN '参与人员' ELSE NULL END AS roleLabel,
span.firstReportDate AS firstReportDate, span.lastReportDate AS lastReportDate, mb.joinDate AS joinDate, mb.leaveDate AS leaveDate,
daily_hrs.report_date NULL AS reportDate, daily_hrs.projectWorkHours AS totalWorkHours FROM pm_project p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pcr.project_id, SUM(c.contract_amount) AS contractAmount FROM pm_project_contract_rel pcr JOIN pm_contract c ON pcr.contract_id = c.contract_id AND c.del_flag = '0' WHERE pcr.del_flag = '0' AND pcr.rel_status = '有效' GROUP BY pcr.project_id ) pc ON pc.project_id = p.project_id INNER JOIN (
SELECT DISTINCT pm.project_id, pm.user_id, '0' AS isFormer FROM pm_project_member pm WHERE pm.is_active = '1' AND pm.del_flag = '0' UNION
SELECT DISTINCT rd.project_id, r.user_id, '1' AS isFormer FROM pm_daily_report r JOIN pm_daily_report_detail rd ON rd.report_id = r.report_id AND rd.entry_type = 'work' AND rd.del_flag = '0' WHERE r.del_flag = '0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pm_project_member pm3 WHERE pm3.project_id = rd.project_id AND pm3.user_id = r.user_id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pm_project_member pm2 WHERE pm2.project_id = rd.project_id AND pm2.user_id = r.user_id AND pm2.is_active = '1' AND pm2.del_flag = '0' ) ) m ON m.project_id = p.project_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = m.user_id INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id
LEFT JOIN sys_dept pd ON pd.dept_id = p.project_dept
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.user_id, rd.project_id, MIN(r.report_date) AS firstReportDate, MAX(r.report_date) AS lastReportDate FROM pm_daily_report r JOIN pm_daily_report_detail rd ON rd.report_id = r.report_id AND rd.entry_type = 'work' AND rd.del_flag = '0' WHERE r.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY r.user_id, rd.project_id ) span ON span.user_id = m.user_id AND span.project_id = p.project_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, user_id, MIN(join_date) AS joinDate, MAX(leave_date) AS leaveDate FROM pm_project_member GROUP BY project_id, user_id ) mb ON mb.project_id = p.project_id AND mb.user_id = m.user_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.user_id, r.report_date, rd.project_id, SUM(rd.work_hours) AS projectWorkHours FROM pm_daily_report r JOIN pm_daily_report_detail rd ON rd.report_id = r.report_id AND rd.entry_type = 'work' AND rd.del_flag = '0' WHERE r.del_flag = '0'
AND r.report_date >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND r.report_date < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
GROUP BY r.user_id, r.report_date, rd.project_id ) daily_hrs ON daily_hrs.user_id = m.user_id AND daily_hrs.project_id = p.project_id
p.del_flag = '0'
AND (p.project_dept = #{deptId} OR p.project_dept IN ( SELECT dept_id FROM sys_dept WHERE FIND_IN_SET(#{deptId}, ancestors) > 0 ))
AND p.project_id = #{projectId}
AND p.revenue_confirm_year IN
#{year}
${params.dataScope}
ORDER BY p.project_id, m.isFormer, u.user_id, daily_hrs.report_date

SELECT d.dept_id AS deptId, CASE WHEN (LENGTH(d.ancestors) - LENGTH(REPLACE(d.ancestors, ',', ''))) = 2 THEN 0 ELSE d.parent_id END AS parentId, d.dept_name AS deptName, d.ancestors, d.order_num AS orderNum FROM sys_dept d WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.status = '0' AND (LENGTH(d.ancestors) - LENGTH(REPLACE(d.ancestors, ',', ''))) >= 2 ${params.dataScope} ORDER BY d.parent_id, d.order_num
mapper.update: update pm_daily_report set total_work_hours = #{hours}, update_time = update_time where report_id = #{reportId}
